उप उप, a prefix to verbs and nouns (ex-
[]
pressing) towards, near to (opposed to अप, away), by
the side of, with, together with, under, down (e. g. उप-
गम्, to go near, undergo; उप-गमन, approach-
ing. In the Veda the verb has sometimes to be supplied
from the context, and sometimes उप is placed after the
verb with which it ought to have been compounded,
e. g. आययुर् उप = उपाययुः, they approached).
(As unconnected with verbs and prefixed to nouns
उप expresses) direction towards, nearness, contiguity
in space, time, number, degree, resemblance, and re-
lationship, but with the idea of subordination and inferi-
ority (e. g. उप-कनिष्ठिका, the finger next to the
little finger; उप-पुराणम्, a secondary or subordinate
Purāṇa; उप-दश, nearly ten); sometimes forming
with the nouns to which it is prefixed compound ad-
verbs (e. g. उप-मूलम्, at the root; उप-पूर्व-
रात्रम्, towards the beginning of night; उप-कूपे,
near a well), which adverbs lose their adverbial ter-
minations if they are again compounded with nouns
(e. g. उपकूप-जलाशय, a reservoir in the neigh-
bourhood of a well). Prefixed to proper names उप
may express in classical literature ‘a younger brother’
(e. g. उपेन्द्र, ‘the younger brother of Indra’), and
in Buddhist literature ‘a son.’
(As a separable adverb उप rarely expresses) thereto,
further, moreover (e. g. तत्र उप ब्रह्म यो वेद,
who further knows the Veda).
(As a separable preposition with locative) near to,
towards, in the direction of, under, below (e. g. उप
आशाः, towards the regions); near to, at, on, upon; at
the time of, upon, up to, in, above (with loc., e. g.
उप सानुषु, on the tops of the mountains); with,
together with, at the same time with, according to
(with inst., e. g. उप धर्मभिः, according to the
rules of duty).
Besides the meanings given above उप is said to
imply disease, extinction; ornament; command; re-
proof; undertaking; giving; killing; diffusing; wish;
power; effort; resemblance, &c.; [cf. Gr. ὑπό Lat.
sub; Goth. up; Old Germ. oba; Mod. Germ. ob
in obdach, obliegen, &c.]

उपक, अस्, m. a diminutive of all proper names
beginning with उप.

उपाक उपाक, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. rt. अञ्च् with
उप), Ved. brought near to one another, joined,
approximate; (ए), Ved. du. an epithet of night and
morning; (ए), ind. in the next neighbourhood, in
the presence of, before.
—उपाक-चक्षस्, आस्, आस्, अस्,
Ved. standing present before the eyes.
उप-ऋ उप-ऋ. See उपार्.

उपकक्ष उप-कक्ष, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. reach-
ing to the shoulder.

उपकण्ठम् उप-कण्ठम्, ind. upon the
neck, near the throat; in the proximity of; (अम्),
n. proximity, neighbourhood, contiguous space; space
near a village or its boundary; one of a horse's paces;
(अस्, आ, अम्), near, proximate.
उपकथा उप-कथा, f. a short story, tale.

उपकनिष्ठिका उप-कनिष्ठिका, f. the last
finger but one; the finger next to the little finger.

उपकन्यापुरम् उप-कन्यापुरम्, ind. near
the women's apartments.
उपकरण, उपकार, &c. See उप-कृ next col.

उपा-करण, अम्, n. bringing near, inviting, in-
vitation to begin; a term applied to certain sentences,
called Praiṣas &c., with which one priest invites an-
other to perform a sacrifice; immolation, sacrifice
of an animal duly consecrated; preparation, begin-
ning; commencement of reading the Veda after the
performance of a preparatory rite.

उपकर्णम् उप-कर्णम्, ind. close to the ear,
into the ear, (whispered &c.)

उपकर्णिका, f. what goes from ear to ear, ru-
mour, report.
उपकल्पन उप-कल्पन. See उप-कॢप्, p. 161.

उप-कल्पन, अम्, आ, n. f. preparation, preparing
articles of food, medicine, &c.; fabricating, making,
substituting.
उपकान्तम् उप-कान्तम्, ind. near a friend.

उपकाल उप-काल, अस्, m., N. of a king of
the Nāgas.
उपकिरण उप-किरण. See उप-कॄ next col.

उप-किरण, अम्, n. scattering or throwing over,
covering up (with earth &c.), burying.

उपकीचक उप-कीचक, अस्, m. a relation or
follower of the Kīcakas.

उपकुञ्चि उप-कुञ्चि, इस्, or उप-कुञ्चिका, f.
the plant Nigella Indica; small cardamoms.

उपकुम्भ उप-कुम्भ, अस्, आ, अम्, near,
proximate; solitary, lonely, retired; (अम्), ind. near
the water-jar.
उपकुर्वाण उप-कुर्वाण. See उप-कृ below.

उप-कुर्वाण, अस्, m. a Brāhman when passing
from the state of a pupil (ब्रह्म-चारिन्) to that of
a householder (गृह-स्थ).

उपकुल्या उप-कुल्या, f. the plant Piper
Longum; a canal, a trench, a ditch.

उपकुश उप-कुश, अस्, m. gum-boil; N. of
a Cakravartin, a son of Kuśa.

उपकूज् उप-कूज्, cl. 1. P. -कूजति, -जितुम्, to
fill with cooing, to make resonant.

उप-कूजित, अस्, आ, अम्, made to resound (with
cooing).

उपकूपे उप-कूपे, ind. near a well; (अम्),
n. a well (?).
—उपकूप-जलाशय, अस्, m. a trough
near a well for watering cattle.
उपकूलम् उप-कूलम्, ind. on the shore.
उपकूलक, अस्, m., N. of a man.

उपकृ उप-कृ, cl. 5. 8. P. A. -कृणोति, -णुते,
-करोति, -कुरुते, -कर्तुम्, to place or bring near, to
furnish with, provide; to assist, serve; favour, benefit;
to foster, take care of; to serve, render homage to (with
acc.); to undertake, begin, set about anything (with
dat.); to place under, subdue; उप-स्-कृ (स् inserted)
A. to add, supply; to furnish with; to elaborate,
prepare, furnish with anything beautiful, to adorn, or-
nament; to care for, take care of (with acc.); to
furnish badly, deform; corrupt; to bring together.

उपकॄ उप-कॄ, cl. 6. P. -किरति, -करितुम्
or -रीतुम्, to scatter or throw down, to scatter upon,
[]
pour upon, besprinkle, bestrew.
—उप-स्-कॄ, to cut
up, split, hurt.

उपाकृ उपा-कृ (उप-आ-कृ), cl. 5. 8. P. A.
-कृणोति, -नुते, -करोति, -कुरुते, -कर्तुम्, to bring
near or towards, to fetch; to summon, invite; to
deliver, commit to, offer, grant, bestow; to acquire,
obtain; to bring about, make preparations for a
sacred action; to undertake, begin; to enter.

उप-कर्तृ, ता, त्री, तृ, doing one a favour, assist-
ing, befriending, one who helps or befriends.

उप-कार, अस्, m. help, assistance, benefit, service,
favour, use, advantage, (उपकारे वृत्, to be of service
to another); preparation, ornament, garlands sus-
pended at gateways as an embellishment on festivals,
a flower &c.; (ई), f. a royal tent, a palace, a caravan-
sera.
—उपकार-पर, अस्, आ, अम्, beneficent, dili-
gent in doing good.
—उपकारापकारौ (˚र-अप्˚),
m. du. kindness and injury.

उप-कारक, अस्, इका, अम्, doing a service or favour,
assisting, protecting, befriending; (इका), f. a protec-
tress, a female assistant; a palace, a caravansera; a
kind of cake.
—उपकारक-त्व, अम्, n. assistance,
protection.

उप-कारिन्, ई, इणी, इ, helping, assisting, doing one
a favour, a benefactor; subsidiary, subservient; (often
used in comp., e. g. परोपकारिन्, helping others.)
—उपकारि-ता, f. or उपकारि-त्व, अम्, n. aid, suc-
cour, protection.

उप-कार्य, अस्, आ, अम्, deserving assistance or
favour; to be assisted; (आ), f. a king's house, a palace,
a caravansera; a royal tent.

उप-कृत, अस्, आ, अम्, assisted, benefited; rendered
as assistance, done kindly or beneficently; (अम्), n.
a favour, a benefit.

उपा-कृत, अस्, आ, अम्, brought near, invited, ad-
dressed with invitatory sentences; (अस्), m. a sacri-
ficial animal killed during the recitation of prescribed
prayers; attended with evil omens, disastrous, cala-
mitous; (अस्), m. misfortune; a portent, a pheno-
menon announcing calamity.
उप-कृति, इस्, f. aid, assistance, favour, kindness.

उप-कृतिन्, ई, इनी, इ, or उपकृति-मत्, आन्, अती,
अत्, one who has done a favour to any body.
उप-क्रिया, f. service, favour.
उप-क्रीय, ind. having bought or purchased.

उपकृत् उप-कृत्, cl. 6. P. -कृन्तति, -कर्ति-
तुम्, to trim, clip off, carp at.

उपकृष् उप-कृष्, cl. 1. P. -कर्षति, -कर्-
ष्टुम् or -क्रष्टुम्, to draw towards, take; to take
away, remove, set aside.

उप-कीर्ण, अस्, आ, अम्, besprinkled, strewed with,
covered.

उपकॢप् उप-कॢप्, cl. 1. A. -कल्पते, -कल्पि-
तुम् or -कल्प्तुम्, to be fit for; to be ready at
hand; to serve as, lead to (with dat.); to take shape
or form, become, be: Caus. -कल्पयति, -यितुम्, to
prepare, make ready, equip; to bring near, to fetch; to
allot, assign; to set up, exhibit; to render (homage),
to communicate; to assume.

उप-कल्पित, अस्, आ, अम्, prepared, made; secon-
dary, substituted.

उप-कॢप्त, अस्, आ, अम्, brought near, at hand,
ready, prepared, equipped, adapted, fitted for; formed,
produced.

उपकोशा उप-कोशा, f., N. of a daughter of
Upa-varṣa and wife of Vararuci.
उपकोसल उप-कोसल, अस्, m., N. of a man.

उपक्रम् उप-क्रम्, cl. 1. P. A., 4. P. -क्रा-
मति, -क्रमते (ep. also -क्रामते), -क्राम्यति,
-क्रमितुम्, to go near, approach, come to; to go
against, attack; to step over, stride; to approach with
any object, have recourse to, to undertake, begin, set
about (with acc. or dat. or inf.), to treat, act towards,
attend on (as a physician).

उपाक्रम् उपा-क्रम् (उप-आ-क्रम्), cl. 1. P. A.,
4. P. -क्रामति, -क्रमते (ep. also -क्रामते),
-क्राम्यति, -क्रमितुम्, to advance against in order
to seize, to fall upon, take possession of.

उप-क्रन्तृ, ता, त्री, तृ, a beginner, one who
undertakes.

उप-क्रम, अस्, m. going near to, approach; un-
dertaking; commencement, beginning; enterprise,
planning, original conception, plan; what leads to
any result, a means, an expedient, a stratagem, ex-
ploit; attendance (on a patient), treatment, practice
of medicine, application of remedies, physicking; a
particular ceremony preparatory to reading the Vedas;
trying the fidelity &c. of a counsellor or friend; re-
tiring from flight, retreat (?).

उप-क्रमण, अम्, n. approaching, undertaking,
attendance (on a patient), treatment.

उपक्रमणीय, अस्, आ, अम्, to be gone to, to be
approached, to be commenced or undertaken; relating
to the attendance (on a patient).

उप-क्रमितव्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be undertaken, to
be commenced.
उप-क्रमितृ, ता, त्री, तृ, one who begins &c.
उप-क्राम्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be attended, to be treated.

उपक्री उप-क्री, cl. 9. P. A. क्रीणाति, -णीते,
-क्रेतुम्, to purchase.

उपक्रीड् उप-क्रीड्, cl. 1. P. (ep. also A.) -क्री-
डति, -ते, -डितुम्, to approach playing, play around.
उप-क्रीडा, f. place for playing, play-ground.

उपक्रुश्य उप-क्रुश्य, ind. (rt. क्रुश्), chiding,
blaming, affecting to be angry.
उप-क्रोश, अस्, m. censure, reproach.
उप-क्रोशन, अम्, n. censuring, blaming.

उप-क्रोष्टृ, टा, m. a censurer, a reprover; an
ass (which brays).

उपक्वण उप-क्वण, अस्, m. (rt. क्वण्), the
sound of a lute.

उपक्वस उप-क्वस, अस्, m., Ved. a kind of
worm or insect.

उपक्षर् उप-क्षर्, cl. 1. P. (ep. also A.)
-क्षरति, -ते, -रितुम्, Ved. -रध्यै, to flow or
stream towards.

उपक्षि 1. उप-क्षि, Pass. -क्षीयते, to waste
away, decay, be consumed, be exhausted, disappear.

उपक्षि 2. उप-क्षि, cl. 2. 6. P. -क्षेति, -क्षि-
यति, -क्षेतुम्, to stay or dwell near or at (with acc.).

उप-क्षय, अस्, m. waste, decay, loss, expenditure,
outlay.

उप-क्षीण, अस्, आ, अम्, decayed, exhausted, con-
sumed, disappeared.

उप-क्षित्, त्, त्, त्, Ved. dwelling near; clinging to,
attached to.

उप-क्षेतृ, ता, त्री, तृ, Ved. one who dwells
near, attached to, a follower; (Sāy.) one who ap-
proaches.

उपक्षिप् उप-क्षिप्, cl. 6. P. A., 4. P.
-क्षिपति, -ते, -क्षिप्यति, -क्षेप्तुम्, to throw at,
hurl against; to throw down; to strike with words,
insult, accuse, insinuate, charge with (a crime).

उप-क्षेप, अस्, m. throwing at, mention, allusion,
threatening; poetical or figurative style in composition.

उप-क्षेपण, अम्, n. throwing down, casting
down, accusing.

उपख्या उप-ख्या, cl. 2. P., Ved. -ख्याति,
-तुम्, to see.

उपाख्या उपा-ख्या (उप-आ-), cl. 2. P. -ख्याति,
-तुम्, to tell a story, narrate; to relate or give an
account about anything (with acc.); to observe (?).

उपा-ख्य, अस्, आ, अम्, observable by the eyes; [cf.
निर्-उपाख्य]; (अस्), m., N. of a man.

उपगण उप-गण, अस्, आ, अम्, constituting a
small or subordinate class; (अस्), m. a small or inferior
class; a small number less than a troop; N. of a man.
उपगन्ध उप-गन्ध, अस्, m. perfume, scent.

उपगम् उप-गम्, cl. 1. P. -गच्छति, -गन्-
तुम्, to go near to, come towards, approach, arrive
at, visit, reach, attain; to come upon, attack; to
occur, happen, present itself; to undertake, begin;
to approach a woman (for intercourse); to enter any
state or relation, undergo; suffer, participate in, make
choice of; to admit, agree to, allow, confess: Caus.
-गमयति, -यितुम्, to cause to come near or ap-
proach: Desid. -जिगमिषति, to wish to approach,
desire to go.

उपागम् उपा-गम् (उप-आ-), cl. 1. P. -गच्छति,
-गन्तुम्, to go near or towards, to approach, visit;
to return; to pass into any condition or relation; to
undergo, suffer, endure; to occur, to come or fall to
one's share.

उप-ग, अस्, आ, अम्, (at the end of a compound)
approaching, following, joining; receiving.

उपगा 1. उप-गा, cl. 3. P. -जिगाति, -गातुम्, to
go near to, arrive at, come into, undergo.
2. उप-गा, f. accompaniment of a song.

उपागा उपा-गा (उप-आ-गा), cl. 3. P. -जिगाति,
गातुम्, to come near, approach, come to.

उप-गत, अस्, आ, अम्, gone to, met, approached,
near at hand, approximate, arrived, occurred, hap-
pened, attained, obtained; undergone, experienced;
become; furnished with; promised, agreed; feeling,
suffering, entertaining; passed away, dead; (अम्), n.
receipt, acquittance.
—उपगत-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, going
to, having gone to or approached; possessing; feeling,
suffering (as sorrow &c.); promising.

उपा-गत, अस्, आ, अम्, approached, arrived; occurred,
happened; promised; suffering, feeling.
उप-गति, इस्, f. going near, approach; undergoing.

उप-गम, अस्, m. approach, approximation, com-
ing to; obtaining; having; acquaintance, society,
intercourse (as of the sexes); undergoing; suffering,
feeling; agreement, promise; a particular high number.

उपा-गम, अस्, m. approach, arrival; occurrence;
promise, agreement; the state of suffering, feeling.

उप-गमन, अम्, n. coming to, obtaining; un-
dertaking, addicting one's self to.

1. उप-गम्य, अस्, आ, अम्, approachable, to be
approached, attainable.

2. उप-गम्य or उप-गत्य, ind. having ap-
proached.

उपा-गम्य or उपा-गत्य, ind. having approached,
having gone near or towards.
उप-गामिन्, ई, इनी, इ, coming near, approaching.
उपगहन उप-गहन, अस्, m., N. of a Ṛṣi.

उपगाह् उप-गाह्, cl. 1. A. -गाहते, -गाहितुम्
or -गाढुम्, to penetrate; force one's way into.
उपगिरम् उप-गिरम्, ind. at a mountain.

उप-गिरि, इस्, m. a country near a mountain; (इ),
ind. near a mountain.

उपगु उप-गु, उस्, m. (fr. उप and गो), N.
of a prince; (उ), ind. near a cow.

उपगुप्त उप-गुप्त, अस्, आ, अम्, hidden, con-
cealed; (अस्), m., N. of a man, the son of Gupta.
—उपगुप्त-वित्त, अस्, आ, अम्, of concealed resources.

उपगुरु उप-गुरु, उस्, m. an assistant teacher;
N. of a prince; (a various reading has उप-गु.)

उपगुह् उप-गुह्, cl. 1. P. A. -गूहति, -ते,
गूहितुम् or -गोढुम्, to hide, cover, conceal, clasp,
embrace.

उप-गूढ, अस्, आ, अम्, hidden, concealed; lulled,
suppressed; embraced; (अम्), n. an embrace.
—उप-
गूढ-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, one who has embraced.

उप-गूहन, अम्, n. hiding, concealing; embrac-
ing, an embrace; astonishment, surprise.

उप-गोह्य, अस्, m. a kind of fire considered as
impure (and therefore to be hidden).

उपगॄ 1. उप-गॄ, cl. 9. P. A., Ved. -गृणाति,
-णीते, -गरितुम् or -रीतुम्, to call out to, invoke
with hymns of praise; to approach with praise (with
acc. of the person).

उपगॄ 2. उप-गॄ, cl. 6. P. -गिरति or -गिलति,
-गरितुम्, -लितुम् or -रीतुम्, -लीतुम्, to swallow down.

उपगै उप-गै, cl. 1. P. -गायति, -गातुम्, to
sing to any one (with dat. or acc.), to join in
singing; to sing before any one (with acc.); to fill
with song, praise in song, sing, celebrate.

उप-गातृ, ता, m. one who accompanies the song
or recitation of the Udgātṛ priest, a chorister.

उप-गीत, अस्, आ, अम्, celebrated, proclaimed, sung
by bards &c.

उप-गीति, इस्, f. a variety of the Āryā metre, a
stanza of four lines, containing twice 12 + 15 syllabic
instants.
उप-गीय, ind. having sung, having celebrated.
उप-गीयमान, अस्, आ, अम्, being celebrated.
उप-गेय, अस्, आ, अम्, to be sung or celebrated.
उप-गेय; add — (अम्), n. a song.

उपग्रन्थ् उप-ग्रन्थ्, cl. 9. 1. 10. P. -ग्रथ्-
नाति, -ग्रन्थति, -ग्रन्थयति, -ग्रन्थितुम्, -यि-
तुम्, to intwine or wind round.

उप-ग्रन्थ, अस्, m. title of a writing or of a
class of writings.

उपग्रस् उप-ग्रस्, cl. 1. P. A. -ग्रसति, -ते,
-ग्रसितुम्, to swallow down, devour; to eclipse.

उपग्रह् उप-ग्रह्, cl. 9. P. A. -गृह्णाति,
-णीते (Ved. -गृभ्णाति, -णीते), -ग्रहीतुम्, to col-
lect (a fluid by holding one vessel under another),
to hold under; to seize from below; to seize, take
possession of, take, obtain; to subdue, become, master
of; to bring near to (one's self), take as one's ally,
conciliate, make favourable; to conceive with one's
mind (धिया); to decide, to determine; to accept,
approve.

उपाग्रह् उपा-ग्रह् (उप-आ-ग्रह्), cl. 9. P. A.
-गृह्णाति, -णीते (Ved. -गृभ्णाति, -णीते), -ग्रहीतुम्,
to comprehend, embrace.

उप-ग्रह, अस्, m. seizure, confinement; a prisoner;
subjoining, annexing; making favourable, appeasing,
favour, encouragement, assistance; peace purchased
by the cession of everything; the voice or pada of a
verb; a heap of Kuśa grass; the presiding spirit or cause
directing a planet's motion; (with उप implying in-
feriority) a minor planet or any heavenly body of a
secondary kind, as a comet, a meteor, a falling star, &c.

उप-ग्राह, अस्, m. oblation, present, (what is ac-
cepted.)

उप-ग्रहण, अम्, n. holding up, seizing from
below; the taking any one prisoner, seizure, capture,
taking, supporting, forwarding, promoting; holy study,
reading the Vedas after initiation.

उपा-ग्रहण, अम्, n. reading the Vedas after
initiation.

उप-ग्राह्य, अस्, अम्, m. n. a present, an offering
to a king or great man, a Nazr.

उपघात उप-घात, अस्, m. (fr. rt. हन् with
उप), a stroke, injury, damage, offence; touch, con-
tact, especially with intent to injure; personal violence,
assault; disease, sickness; a kind of oblation offered
in small portions at a time.

उप-घातक, अस्, इका, अम्, or उप-घातिन्, ई, इनी,
इ, injuring, hurting, offending.

उप-घ्न, अस्, m. contiguous support; a contiguous
resting-place, shelter, support, stay, protection; what
rests upon or is supported by.

उपघुष् उप-घुष्, cl. 1. P. -घोषति, -षि-
तुम्, to fill with noise, make resonant.

उप-घुष्ट, अस्, आ, अम्, resounding with; reso-
nant; sounding.

उप-घोषण, अम्, n. proclaiming, publication,
making known.

उपघ्रा उप-घ्रा, cl. 1. P. -जिघ्रति, -घ्रातुम्,
to smell, smell at; to kiss: Caus. -घ्रापयति,
-यितुम्, to cause to smell at or kiss.

उपाघ्रा उपा-घ्रा (उप-आ-घ्रा), cl. 1. P.
-जिघ्रति, -घ्रातुम्, to smell at; to kiss.

उपचक्र उप-चक्र, अस्, m. a variety of the
ruddy goose, Cakra or Cakravāka.

उपचतुर उप-चतुर, आस्, आस्, आणि, pl. almost
four, nearly four.
उपचय उप-चय. See 1. उप-चि.

उप-चय, अस्, m. accumulation, increase, growth,
prosperity; quantity, heap; elevation, excess; addi-
tion; the third, sixth, tenth, and eleventh degrees
from the first of a zodiacal sign.
—उपचय-भवन,
अम्, n. (?) according to some, a species of the Daṇ-
ḍaka metre.
—उपचयापचयौ (˚य-अप्˚), m. du.
prosperity and decay, rise and fall.

उप-चाय्य, अस्, m. a certain sacrificial fire; a place
for holding sacrificial fire, a hearth, an altar.

उपचर् उप-चर्, cl. 1. P. A. -चरति, -ते,
-चरितुम्, Ved. -रितवे, -वै, -रसे, -रध्यै,
to come near, approach, go towards; to approach
with the intention of serving, to assist, serve, attend,
wait on (with acc.); to attend on a patient, to
tend, nurse; to undertake; begin: Pass. -चर्यते,
to be used figuratively or metaphorically, to be applied
figuratively to any one (with loc.).

उपाचर् उपा-चर् (उप-आ-), cl. 1. P. A. -च-
रति, -ते, -रितुम्, Ved. -तवे, &c., to come near to;
to attend upon, be attached to, to wait on, serve; to
be obedient; to treat.
उप-चर, अस्, m. approach; attendance, cure.

उप-चार, अस्, m. approach, service, attendance,
act of civility, obliging or polite behaviour; proceed-
ing, practice; profession, usage; physicking, the prac-
tice of medicine, tending the sick, nursing; behaviour,
conduct; a ceremony, presenting offerings of water,
betel, flowers, &c.; a present, a bribe; solicitation,
request; incomplete act; a figure of speech, pre-
tence, pretext, ellipsis, metaphor (e. g. उपचारात्,
metaphorically); occurrence of स् and ष् in the place
of Visarga in grammar; N. of a Pariśiṣṭa of the
Sāma-veda.
—उपचार-करण, अम्, n. or उपचार-
कर्मन्, अ, n. or उपचार-क्रिया, f. offering presents,
especially of perfumes, flowers, &c.; attention, service.
—उपचार-पर, अस्, आ, अम्, diligent in service,
serving diligently.
—उपचार-परिभ्रष्ट, अस्, आ,
अम्, void of civility, destitute of kindness, churlish,
uncourteous.

उपा-चार, अस्, m. position (as of a word in a
sentence); procedure; Sandhi by which the sound
Visarga becomes स् before क् and प्.
उप-चरण, अम्, n. going near to, approaching.
उप-चरित, अस्, आ, अम्, waited on, served, adored.

उपा-चरित, अस्, आ, अम्, attached to any one's
service, obedient; (in gram.) that rule of Sandhi by
which the sound Visarga becomes स् before क् and प्.

1. उप-चर्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be served or waited on,
to be worshipped; (आ), f. service, attendance; practice
of medicine, physicking.

2. उप-चर्य, ind. having approached or attended
to; having groomed or tended (horses).
उप-चार्य, अस्, m. practice of medicine.
उप-चारिन्, ई, इणी, इ, attending, serving.

उपचर्म उप-चर्म or अम्, ind. on the skin,
near the skin.

उपचारु उप-चारु, उस्, m. and उपचारु-मत्,
आन्, m., N. of two Cakravartins.

उपचि 1. उप-चि, cl. 5. P. A. -चिनोति, -नुते,
-चेतुम्, to gather together; to heap up, collect, hoard
up, accumulate, increase, strengthen; to cover over
with: Pass. -चीयते, to be heaped together or accu-
mulated, to increase, become strong; to better one's
circumstances, be prosperous; to gain advantage,
succeed, to be covered with.

उपचि 2. उप-चि, cl. 3. P., Ved. -चिकेति, -चे-
तुम्, to honour, worship.

उप-चायिन्, ई, इनी, इ, increasing, being in good
circumstances.

उप-चित्, त्, f., Ved. a kind of disease, perhaps a
swelling.

उप-चित, अस्, आ, अम्, collected, gathered together,
heaped up, increased, assembled; thriving, increas-
ing; abundantly furnished with, plastered, smeared;
burnt (?).
—उपचित-रस, अस्, आ, अम्, augmented in
feeling.
उप-चिति, इस्, f. accumulation, collection, abundance.
उप-चीयमान, अस्, आ, अम्, being collected or filled.
उप-चेय, अस्, आ, अम्, to be collected or heaped up.

उपचित्तचिन्त उपचित्त-चिन्त, अस्, m., N. of
a son of Pāpīyas.

उपचूलन उप-चूलन, अम्, n. heating, burn-
ing (?).

उपचृत् उप-चृत्, cl. 6. P. -चृतति, -चर्तितुम्,
to fasten, tie, bind on.

उपच्छद् 1. उप-च्छद् (उप-छद्), cl. 10. P.
A. -छादयति, -ते, -यितुम्, to cover, hide, conceal,
keep secret.

उपच्छद् 2. उप-च्छद् or -च्छन्द् (उप-छद्),
Caus. -च्छन्दयति, -यितुम्, to present any one
(acc.) with anything (inst.); to persuade a person
to do anything; to coax, to seek to seduce a person;
to conciliate.
उप-च्छन्न, अस्, आ, अम्, secret, concealed.

उप-च्छन्दन, अम्, n. persuasion, persuading,
coaxing.

उपच्यव उप-च्यव, अस्, m. (rt. च्यु), Ved.
pressing close to (in sexual intercourse); (Sāy.) going
into (the chamber).

उपजगती उप-जगती, f. a variety of the
Triṣṭubh metre, in which three Pādas contain twelve
syllables instead of eleven.

उपजन् उप-जन्, cl. 4. A. -जायते, -जनितुम्,
to be produced in addition, to be born, originate; to
happen, become visible, appear; to be born again;
to exist, be: Caus. -जनयति, -यितुम्, to produce,
cause.

उप-ज, अस्, आ, अम्, being produced in addition,
increasing; (अस्), m., N. of a divine being (?).
उप-जा, f., Ved. distant or not immediate posterity.

उप-जन, अस्, m. additional production, addition,
increase; appendage; addition of a letter in the forma-
tion of words; letters, syllables or affixes added.

उप-जात, अस्, आ, अम्, produced, engendered, aroused.
—उपजात-कोप or उपजात-क्रोध, अस्, आ, अम्,
provoked, excited, moved to anger.
—उपजात-
विश्वास, अस्, आ, अम्, believing, confiding, confident,
trusting.

उप-जाति, इस्, f. a mixed metre, especially a con-
junction of Indravajrā and Upendravajrā, and a con-
junction of Vaṃśastha and Indravaṃśa.

उपजप् उप-जप्, cl. 1. P. -जपति, -जपितुम्,
to whisper into the ears (of another), to bring over
to one's own party by secretly suggesting anything in
the ear, to instigate to rebellion or treachery; to
make mischief.

उप-जप्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be brought over or in-
stigated to rebellion by secret suggestions or whisper-
ing in the ear.

उप-जाप, अस्, m. the act of whispering into the
ears, rousing to rebellion, bringing over to one's own
party; treason, treachery; disunion, separation.

उपजरसम् उप-जरसम्, ind. towards old
age, in old age.
उपजला उप-जला, f., N. of a river.

उपजल्प् उप-जल्प्, cl. 1. P. -जल्पति, -पितुम्,
to talk to, chatter, advise.
उप-जल्पित, अम्, n. talk.

उप-जल्पिन्, ई, इनी, इ, talking to a person, giving
advice.
उपजायम् उप-जायम्, ind. near a wife.

उपजिगमिषु उप-जिगमिषु, उस्, उस्, उ (fr.
Desid. of rt. गम्), desirous of going near.

उपजिहीर्षा उप-जिहीर्षा, f. (fr. Desid. of
rt. हृ with उप), desire, intention to rob.

उपजिह्वा उप-जिह्वा or उपजिह्विका, f. the
uvula or soft palate, the epiglottis; enlargement of
the under side of the tongue; a kind of ant.
उपजीक उपजीक, अस्, m., Ved. a water deity.

उपजीव् उप-जीव्, cl. 1. P. -जीवति, -वितुम्,
to live or exist upon (food), subsist, support one's self
on, be supported by, derive profit from, make use of
(with acc.); to live under, be dependant on, to serve;
to live for a profession, practice.
उप-जीव, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. living on &c. (?).

उप-जीवक, अस्, आ, अम्, living upon, subsisting by
(with inst.); living under, depending upon, subject to,
a dependant; (अम्), n. means of subsistence, act.
उप-जीवन, अम्, n. means of living, subsistence.

उप-जीवनीय, अस्, आ, अम्, granting means of sub-
sistence, affording a livelihood.
उप-जीविका, f. subsistence, livelihood.

उप-जीविन्, ई, इनी, इ, living on, subsisting by (with acc.
or gen.); living in dependance, dependant, subject.

उप-जीव्य, अस्, आ, अम्, that by which one lives,
affording a livelihood; (अम्), n. means of subsistence,
cause.

उपजोषम् उप-जोषम्, ind. (rt. जुष्), ac-
cording to one's desire or pleasure, quietly; an expres-
sion indicative of joy.
उप-जोषण, अम्, n. enjoying, frequenting.

उपज्ञा 1. उप-ज्ञा, cl. 9. A. -जानीते, -ज्ञातुम्,
to ascertain; excogitate, invent, find out, hit upon:
Desid. A., ep. also P. -जिज्ञासते, -ति, to seek to
ascertain or invent.

2. उप-ज्ञा, f. a knowledge obtained by one's self
and not handed down by tradition, primitive or un-
taught knowledge, invention; commencement of a
thing not previously done; (at the end of a compound
used in neut., e. g. पाणिन्य्-उपज्ञम्, the grammar
invented by Pāṇini.)

उप-जिज्ञास्य, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. enigmatical, unin-
telligible, mysterious.

उपज्मन् उप-ज्मन्, आ, m., Ved. striding or
stepping upon (?).
उपज्योतिष उप-ज्योतिष, N. of a region.

उपज्रि उप-ज्रि, cl. 1. P., Ved. -ज्रयति, -ज्रे-
तुम्, to extend to; (Sāy.) to go near to, approach.
उपज्वलित उप-ज्वलित, अस्, आ, अम्, lighted up.

उपढौक् उप-ढौक्, Caus. P. -ढौकयति,
-यितुम्, to present an offering, make a respectful
offering; carry out, accomplish.

उप-ढौकन, अम्, n. a respectful offering or
present, a Nazr.

उपतक्ष उप-तक्ष, अस्, m., N. of a certain
semi-divine being, belonging to the class of Gandhar-
vas or of Nāgas.

उपतटम् उप-तटम्, ind. near the skirt;
(अस्), m. (?) the skirt.

उपतप् उप-तप्, cl. 1. P. -तपति, -तप्तुम्,
to make warm, to heat; to feel pain, become sick;
to afflict, befal (as an illness; sometimes used im-
personally with gen. or acc.): Pass. -तप्यते, to feel
pain, become ill, be afflicted with; to be emaciated
with penance (तपस्): Caus. -तापयति, -यितुम्,
to kindle, ignite, burn, consume; to cause pain, ma-
cerate the body by penance; torment, hurt, offend,
oppress.

उप-तपत्, अम्, m., Ved. (scil. अग्नि) interior heat,
a disease.

उप-तप्त, अस्, आ, अम्, heated, parched; distressed,
pained.

उप-तप्तृ, ता, m. morbid heat; any cause of
heat, burning or inflammation.
उप-तप्यमान, अस्, आ, अम्, being distressed.
उप-तापन, अम्, n. heating, distressing.

उप-तापिन्, ई, इनी, इ, heating, inflaming, exciting,
causing pain; suffering heat or pain, sick.

उपतारक उप-तारक, अस्, इका, अम् (rt. तॄ),
overflowing.

उपतिष्य उप-तिष्य, अस्, m., N. of a son of
Tiṣya by Śārikā.
उपतीरम् उप-तीरम्, ind. on the shore.

उपतुष् उप-तुष्, Caus. -तोषयति, -यितुम्,
to content, satisfy.
उपतूलम् उप-तूलम्, ind. at the cotton.

उपतृण्य उप-तृण्य, अस्, m., Ved. epithet of
a snake (lurking in grass).

उपत्य उपत्य, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. उप), situated
under or below.

उपत्यका, f. low-land, land at the foot of a hill
or mountain; a forest at the foot of a mountain; a
vale, valley.

उपदंश् उप-दंश्, cl. 1. P. -दशति, -दंष्-
टुम्, to bite or eat anything as a relish.

उप-दंश, अस्, m. a relish, anything to excite
drinking or appetite, anything eaten in addition;
biting, stinging; the venereal disease, chancre; a tree,
the scraped root of which is used for horse-radish,
Morunga Hyperanthera.

उपदंशिन्, ई, इनी, इ, afflicted with the above
disease.
उपदधि उप-दधि. See under 1. उप-धा.
उप-दधि, इस्, इस्, इ, Ved. placing upon.

उपदम्भ् उप-दम्भ्, Caus. P., Ved. -दम्भ-
यति, -यितुम्, to lesson, diminish, destroy.

उपदश उप-दश, आस्, आस्, आनि, pl. almost ten,
nearly ten.

उपदस् उप-दस्, cl. 4. P. -दस्यति, -सितुम्,
to fail, be wanting, be extinguished, be exhausted, dry
up; (in Ved. used impersonally with inst. or abl.):
Caus. P. -दासयति, -यितुम्, to cause to fail or cease,
extinguish.
उप-दासुक, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. failing, wanting.

उपदह् उप-दह्, cl. 1. P. -दहति, -दग्धुम्,
to burn, set fire to.

उपदा 1. उप-दा, cl. 3. P. A. -ददाति, -दत्ते,
दातुम्, to give in addition, offer, grant, give; to
add: Ved. cl. 1. A. -ददते, to take upon one's self;
to erect, support.

उपादा उपा-दा (उप-आ-दा), cl. 3. A. -दत्ते,
दातुम्, to receive, accept; to gain, acquire; to
take, appropriate to one's self; to take away or off,
carry off, steal; to seize, lay hold of, gather; to draw
(water); to assume a form; to feel, perceive, consider,
regard; to take in addition, include, comprise; to
employ, apply, use; to undertake, begin; to men-
tion, enumerate: Caus. -दापयति, -यितुम्, to cause
to employ or apply; to make use of: Desid. P.
-दित्सति, to strive to obtain.

उप-दान or उपदानक, अम्, n. an oblation, a
present; a gift which is for the purpose of procuring
favour or protection.

उपा-दान, अम्, n. taking, acquiring, taking away,
abduction, appropriating to one's self, accepting, em-
ployment, using, becoming familiar with; mentioning,
enumeration; saying, speaking; including, containing;
abstraction, withdrawing the organs of sense and per-
ception from the outer world; cause, motive; imme-

diate or proximate cause; the formal or distinct form,
the material cause; a double meaning, an expression
conveying a sense besides that which appears in-
tended; (with Buddhists) conception; effort or ex-
ertion of body or speech.
—उपादान-कारण, अम्,
n. a proximate cause.

उपदानवी उप-दानवी, f., N. of the daughter
of the Dānava Vṛṣa-parvan and mother of Dush-
manta.

उपदिग्ध उप-दिग्ध, अस्, आ, अम्, (fr. rt. दिह्
with उप), smeared, covered; spotted over.
उप-देहिका, f. a kind of ant; [cf. उपजिह्विका.]

उपदिश् 1. उप-दिश्, cl. 6. P. A. -दिशति, -ते,
-देष्टुम्, to point out to; to indicate, specify, ex-
plain, instruct, teach; advise, admonish; to assign the
right place to anything, arrange; to mention, exhibit;
to inform; to settle, prescribe; to dictate, command,
govern; to name: Pass. -दिश्यते, to be taught &c.,
to be called.

2. उप-दिश्, क्, or उप-दिशा, f. an intermediate
region, as north-east &c.

उपादिश् उपा-दिश् (उप-आ-), cl. 6. P. A. -दि-
शति, -ते, -देष्टुम्, to advise, show, point out, to indi-
cate, inform, declare; to prescribe, give an order.
उप-दिश, अस्, m., N. of a son of Vasu-deva.
उप-दिश्य, ind. having advised or instructed.

ing, informing, advice, prescription; specification; plea,
pretext; initiation, communication of the initiatory
Mantra or formula; (in gram.) a form in a rule, an
indicatory form, i. e. a root, base, affix, augment, or
any other word or part of a word furnished with in-
dicatory letters (anubandhas) which serve as a guide
to the application of particular grammatical rules and
are rejected when the word or part of a word is ready
for use.
—उपदेश-ता, f. the state of being a precept
